beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: There is a chair, Baron. You needn't stand on ceremony.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: Miri. Pick up your things.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: They're where I want them.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: We have discussed this.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: You discussed it. I was in the room.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: You must be—

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: Baron Revus Veln.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Yes. The atmosphere suggested a title.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: This is the man you intend to follow?

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Work with.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: An Ash Quarter tavern performer. No standing. No proper patronage.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: The tavern does have a standing audience. When the chairs run out.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: I am speaking to my daughter.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Then stop talking about me as though I've left.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: You have a home. Protection. A future that does not depend on whether this boy survives his next bad idea.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: And the people who don't have those things?

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: They are not your responsibility.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: That answer is why I'm here.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: You know what people will say.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: You've been rehearsing it for them.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: A Veln should know her worth.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: I do. You keep confusing it with a price.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: If you expect me to approve—

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: I don't. I would like you to visit.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: Have you eaten, Miri? Properly? And are you sleeping?

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Father. You can ask that at supper.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: Yes. Quite. Supper.

beats.speaker: Revus
beats.text: Do not make me regret leaving you here.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: I was staying either way, Father.

beats.caption: A choice made in her own name.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: You held your ground. That takes more than a shield.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: For what it's worth, I can provide references.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: From the tavern?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Some of them can write.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Show me the armoury.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Certainly. We have a cupboard.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: We'll start with the cupboard.

beats.speaker: Marli
beats.text: Not the one with the clean glasses.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Torren Stonekin. A-rank Guardian. Which way's the kitchen?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I had a welcome speech prepared.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Give it to the onions. They look moved already.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Was that part of the interview?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Aye. Shelf failed.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: And who might this fine lady be?

beats.speaker: Marli
beats.text: The woman who decides whether you get a kitchen key.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Then let me begin again. Torren Stonekin. Excellent references. Very clean pans.

beats.speaker: Marli
beats.text: And the badge?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: A-rank.

beats.speaker: Marli
beats.text: Does it peel potatoes?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Watch closely.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Remarkable defensive instincts.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: A-rank.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: There it is again.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Is the spoon supposed to stand up by itself?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Saves ye holding it.

beats.speaker: Marli
beats.text: You planning to feed an army?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Depends. How many are we bringing home?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: As many as we can.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Right. Bigger pot tomorrow.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Pressure cooker? Four valves. Five, if you want it to remain a cooker.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: If it stands up on its own, does it count as a sparring partner?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Spent enough years building things for men who never asked who'd be underneath them.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: And now?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Now I want to know who's coming back for supper.

beats.speaker: Marli
beats.text: You'll do.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: High praise from a beautiful woman. Best keep that between us.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: There are three of us in the room.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Then two of ye can practise discretion.

beats.speaker: Marli
beats.text: Is that a portion or a challenge?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Depends how hungry ye are.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: A bowl for the lady?

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Is this dinner or a demonstration?

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: With me, lass, ye get both.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Then demonstrate a smaller portion.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Sensible woman.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Feet apart. Eyes up. Jory—enthusiasm is not a guard stance.

beats.speaker: Jory
beats.text: It is when I do it with rhythm!

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: I am improving the lesson.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Excellent. No notes.

beats.speaker: Rava
beats.text: You said one more round.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: We had one more round.

beats.speaker: Rava
beats.text: You didn't say it was the last one.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: A signal from the orphanage if you need us. Someone will answer.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: I'll be staying here with the Flameguard for a while.

beats.speaker: Nyx
beats.text: The Fiery Tornado. This poster says forty percent more cape.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Those shoulder pads could apply for their own guild rank.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: I couldn't turn my head left.

beats.speaker: Jory
beats.text: We thought it needed more cape.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Of course. That was what it was missing.

beats.speaker: Nyx
beats.text: But who'll stay at the orphanage?

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Your carers are staying at the orphanage. I've checked the watches. Twice.

beats.speaker: Rava
beats.text: You've always been there.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: I know.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: There's trouble outside these walls. If I wait for it to reach the orphanage door, I've waited too long.

beats.speaker: Jory
beats.text: So you're going to hit it first?

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: I'm going to try talking first.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I'm very good at that part.

beats.speaker: Jory
beats.text: And if it doesn't listen?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: She handles the second conversation.

beats.speaker: Rava
beats.text: What if you fall down?

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Then I won't be on my own.

beats.speaker: Rava
beats.text: You have to help her up.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I will.

beats.speaker: Nyx
beats.text: So you remember the team.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: I know my team.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Once more. Show me.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Packed lunches. Proper portions. Don't let the bard ration them.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Should I announce the Tornado?

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Announce lunch. They'll actually follow you.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: We found you a rather impressive chair.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: I noticed. It has more ornament than the room has medical supplies.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: You haven't even seen the cushions.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Can they stop bleeding?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I'll ask Marli about bandages.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Clean water here. Dressings here. No cups on the bookshelves.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I feel that last rule was written before you arrived.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: It was confirmed when I arrived.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Where do I put the tools that might explode?

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Outside. We can begin with that rule.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Is this why you left your order? Poor shelving?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Sorry. That wasn't—

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: No. It's a fair question.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: They called them transfers. I knew some of the children. They hadn't moved.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Their names had.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Sold under the church's seal. I took the ledger to my superiors. They asked who had given me permission to read it.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: What did you tell them?

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: That I would like an answer to my question first.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: They didn't give you one.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: They gave me an order.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: I believe in discipline. People trust a healer to be ready. To keep his hands clean. To arrive when he says he will.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: I will not let them use that trust to make obedience look holy.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: If someone comes here needing help, what do we charge?

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: For clean water, a dressing, a little kindness? Nothing.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Even if they cannot give you their name?

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Especially then. A name is not a price of admission.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: So. How many rules are you bringing with you?

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: I had seven. Then I met you.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: We can have them printed.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Leave space at the bottom.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Wash that first.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: That's the water bowl.

beats.speaker: Sparky
beats.text: Prrrp?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: A bold interpretation. We'll get a second one.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Oh, sweetheart.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Wait. Let him do it.

beats.speaker: Sparky
beats.text: Rrr!

beats.caption: A very small foot. A very large impact.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Did you see his little foot?

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: I saw it.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: He was trying so hard.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: I saw that as well.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Careful. I don't know what it—

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: He.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: His name is Sparky.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I know his name. I meant—

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I know his name. I meant—

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Then you have several good alternatives.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: Try one.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Sparky. I am sorry. I don't know what you like to eat yet.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: That is not a suggestion.

beats.speaker: Sparky
beats.text: Prrr.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: There. Forgiven.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: By him.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: An important distinction.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Is this all right? Staying here?

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: I think so.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Shall I put “Flameguard” on his bowl?

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Put his name on it.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: Finally. Someone who appreciates the service.

beats.speaker: Seerin
beats.text: A tiny portion, Torren.

beats.speaker: Torren
beats.text: That is a tiny portion.

shortBeats.speaker: Verseborn
shortBeats.text: A bold interpretation. We'll get a second one.

shortBeats.speaker: Verseborn
shortBeats.text: Sparky. Is this all right? Staying here?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Good news. I came back.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: You told Stonewake?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: I told Kaeldrin. Very professionally.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: How professionally?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Only one demonstration. And I put the pin back in before the end.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: He wanted a maintenance report. I wanted to talk about what that machine could do for people.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: And?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Stonewake taught me to be useful. Here, I think I could belong. That is rather more frightening.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Then let us start with a bench. You do not have to earn the right to belong here.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: I noticed. It has potential.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: You could have stayed somewhere established.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Yes. And maintained things that already work. Here, when something breaks, somebody actually needs it fixed.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: People. Not just equipment. You are trying to bring people home. I can build things that help.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Then the bench is yours.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Excellent. I have improved it already.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Why is it smoking?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Because progress is happening.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: I admire the confidence. I fear the result.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Both are correct.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: Where do you put the tools that might explode?

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Where do you put the tools that might explode?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Within reach. That is what makes them useful.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Could we agree on a warning first?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: The little light turns purple.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: It is purple now.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: See? An excellent warning system.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: Glinda.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Professional names, Mira. We discussed this.

beats.speaker: Mira
beats.text: My mistake.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: I built Torren a locking hinge once. He jammed it during a collapse. Once. A statistical miracle.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: You are proud of that?

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Of him holding up the building? Yes. Of the hinge? We do not discuss the hinge.

beats.speaker: Kael
beats.text: No cups on the bookshelves. No live current on the medical table.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Separate tables. Sensible. I like working with professionals.

beats.speaker: Verseborn
beats.text: Welcome to the Flameguard, Glimmer.

beats.speaker: Glimmer
beats.text: Good. Now hold this. Carefully.
